unisoc-s752-arm.title: S752 tablet-platform specifications
unisoc-s752-arm.note: Product specifications identify Arm Mali G57 graphics and A76/A55 CPU cores. Undated page checked November 25, 2026. No foundry is named by the process-node specification.

empyrean-huahong-2017.title: Hua Hong adopts ALPS and Skipper EDA tools (joint release)
empyrean-huahong-2017.note: Joint company announcement, reproduced by Design & Reuse, reports ALPS simulation used for completed IP tape-outs and earlier Skipper adoption.

tsmc-2013-materials.title: 2013 annual report: raw-material supply
tsmc-2013-materials.note: The materials table names Air Liquide, Air Products, Linde and Taiyo Nippon Sanso as specialty-gas suppliers. Historical annual-report evidence.

dupont-tsmc-2025-tcia.title: 2025 Taiwan Continuous Improvement Awards: supplier participants
dupont-tsmc-2025-tcia.note: TSMC identifies DuPont Specialty Materials Taiwan among its award-winning suppliers. Award groups are not supplier-chain depth levels.

advanced-energy-2024-revenue.title: 2024 Form 10-K, Note 3: significant customers
advanced-energy-2024-revenue.note: Applied Materials and Lam account for 26% and 11% of 2024 revenue respectively. This filing names these customers, correcting the earlier blanket anonymity claim.

nsig-2025-trustee.title: NSIG bond trustee report based on issuer disclosures
nsig-2025-trustee.note: Issuer-supplied business information reproduced in the trustee filing names TSMC, UMC, GlobalFoundries, ST, Towerjazz, SMIC and Hua Hong Grace among wafer customers.

xingfu-2024-ipo-response.title: IPO inquiry response: customers and raw-material purchases
xingfu-2024-ipo-response.note: Printed pp.69-70 and 81 identify YMTC and CXMT sales and Hua Hong Grace as an existing customer. Printed p.3 identifies purchases of yellow phosphorus from Xingfa and subsidiaries. These are recorded transactions, not a list of competitors.

arteris-customers-2022.title: AI and NoCs Are Driving the Future of ADAS, slide 8 (PDF page 10)
arteris-customers-2022.note: Company-authored conference slides hosted by TechInsights. Visually checked the customer panel (data as of June 2022), which includes Biren, Cambricon, UNISOC, Bosch, NXP, Samsung, Renesas, ST, Microchip and TI. Ecosystem-partner logos below that panel are NOT treated as customers.

arteris-cambricon-2017.title: Cambricon licenses FlexNoC interconnect IP
arteris-cambricon-2017.note: Supplier announcement explicitly records a Cambricon FlexNoC license for machine-learning SoCs.

pti-2023-awards.title: 2023 ESG Insight: customer recognition, page 5
pti-2023-awards.note: Downloaded and visually checked page 5: Micron external-manufacturing supplier award and Winbond assembly/testing supplier recognition, both for 2023.

skmaterials-2019-airgas.title: 4Q2019 investor presentation: major subsidiaries, slide 7 (PDF page 8)
skmaterials-2019-airgas.note: Downloaded and visually checked the SK Airgas customer map: SK Hynix Icheon and Cheongju on-site supply. SK Airgas was then wholly owned by SK Materials.

torlens-2026-ipo-response.title: IPO inquiry response: customer sales and outsourced processing
torlens-2026-ipo-response.note: Printed p.260 shows sales to NAURA and AMEC; pp.286-287 name Donghelong Kunshan and Anhui Fude as paid surface-treatment subcontractors. Raw-material supplier names elsewhere are not automatically linked to the equipment buyers.

amd-q4-2024-downstream.title: Q4 2024 earnings presentation, slides 23-24
amd-q4-2024-downstream.note: Names cloud launches, enterprise deployments and server platforms. Adoption does not disclose direct purchasing channels or volumes.

nvidia-drive-customers-2025.title: Toyota, Aurora and Continental adopt NVIDIA DRIVE
nvidia-drive-customers-2025.note: Named automotive platform adoption and development. Continental mass manufacture of Aurora Driver was planned for 2027, not confirmed production.

infineon-rivian-r2-2025.title: Power modules for Rivian R2 traction inverters
infineon-rivian-r2-2025.note: Announced HybridPACK Drive G2, AURIX TC3x and OPTIREG supply for R2, expected to start in 2026. Actual start not confirmed by this source.

marvell-aws-agreement-2024.title: Expanded AWS relationship: semiconductor supply and EDA cloud infrastructure
marvell-aws-agreement-2024.note: Five-year agreement names both directions: Marvell semiconductor products for AWS and AWS cloud compute for Marvell chip design.

xiaomi-14t-specifications.title: Xiaomi 14T specifications
xiaomi-14t-specifications.note: Official product specifications name the MediaTek Dimensity 8300-Ultra. Undated page; access date is not a shipment date.

asm-supplier-day-2024.title: Supplier Day 2024 performance and sustainability awards
asm-supplier-day-2024.note: Names Benchmark Electronics, Foxsemicon, Horiba and Celestica as suppliers. KLK omitted because the short name does not resolve an unambiguous entity here.

hemlock-sumco-award-2022.title: SUMCO Japan 2022 Supplier of the Year award
hemlock-sumco-award-2022.note: Article describes the 2022 award and polysilicon supply relationship. Page also displays a later September 2025 update date.

aws-ansys-gateway-2023.title: Architecture of Ansys Gateway powered by AWS
aws-ansys-gateway-2023.note: Joint AWS/Ansys technical article states the control plane is hosted in Ansys AWS account; application compute runs in end customers accounts.

azure-synopsys-cloud-2022.title: Synopsys Cloud on Azure
azure-synopsys-cloud-2022.note: Microsoft names Azure as the infrastructure running Synopsys Cloud chip-design and verification tools.

alibaba-xpeng-cloud-2024.title: Customer deployments of cloud infrastructure and AI models
alibaba-xpeng-cloud-2024.note: Names XPENG as a user of Alibaba Cloud models and cloud computing for smart cockpit and autonomous driving.

anthropic-cloud-compute-2025.title: Expansion of Google Cloud TPUs and services
anthropic-cloud-compute-2025.note: Names Google Cloud TPU use and expansion plans, and Amazon as primary training partner and cloud provider.

tower-semtech-shipments-2024.title: Semtech recognizes CY2024 wafer manufacturing and shipments
tower-semtech-shipments-2024.note: Names Semtech and actual CY2024 wafer shipments using Tower SiGe technology for connectivity ICs.

renesas-tsmc-2012-outsourcing.title: TSMC microcontroller manufacturing agreement
renesas-tsmc-2012-outsourcing.note: Renesas describes existing 90nm MCU outsourcing and an agreement to extend manufacturing to 40nm and future processes.

infineon-tsmc-2009-production.title: Extension of embedded-flash development and production agreement
infineon-tsmc-2009-production.note: Joint announcement extends the development and production partnership to 65nm embedded flash.

arm-nvidia-grace-ip.title: NVIDIA partner profile: Grace CPU and BlueField processors
arm-nvidia-grace-ip.note: Undated profile checked November 25, 2026 identifies Neoverse V2 cores in Grace and Arm processors in BlueField.

nvidia-qct-2024-systems.title: Computer manufacturers announce Blackwell systems
nvidia-qct-2024-systems.note: Names QCT among manufacturers announcing systems using NVIDIA GPUs and networking; Quanta chairman confirms participation.

rapidus-asml-delivery-2024.title: Engineering interview describing EUV equipment arrival
rapidus-asml-delivery-2024.note: Rapidus describes receiving ASML EUV lithography equipment in December 2024.

renesas-wolfspeed-sic-2023.title: Renesas and Wolfspeed Sign 10 Year Silicon Carbide Wafer Supply Agreement
renesas-wolfspeed-sic-2023.note: Supplier-hosted joint release. States that the agreement calls for Wolfspeed to provide Renesas with 150mm silicon carbide bare and epitaxial wafers, and anticipates 200mm wafers later. A ten-year commitment secured by a deposit; no delivered volume is disclosed.

renesas-gf-foundry-2026.title: GlobalFoundries and Renesas Expand Partnership to Accelerate U.S. Semiconductor Manufacturing
renesas-gf-foundry-2026.note: Buyer-hosted joint release. Renesas describes broadened access to GF's FDX (FD-SOI), BCD and feature-rich CMOS technologies for its SoCs, power devices and MCUs, beginning in the United States. Tape-outs are stated as on track to begin in mid-2026, so this is contracted access rather than production in hand. The printed date is February 17, 2026; the page metadata carries February 16.

renesas-andes-riscv-2020.title: Renesas Selects Andes RISC-V 32-Bit CPU Cores for its First RISC-V Implementation of ASSPs
renesas-andes-riscv-2020.note: Buyer names its IP supplier: Renesas selected AndesCore 32-bit RISC-V CPU cores to embed into new application-specific standard products, sampling from the second half of 2021. Renesas has since published an in-house RISC-V core as well, so this is one line of its RISC-V products and not all of them.

renesas-sifive-riscv-2021.title: Renesas and SiFive Partner to Jointly-Develop Next-Generation High-End RISC-V Solutions for Automotive Applications
renesas-sifive-riscv-2021.note: Buyer names its IP supplier: the partnership includes SiFive licensing the use of their RISC-V core IP portfolio to Renesas. Joint development announced, with no product shipping on the announcement date. The printed date is April 21, 2021; the page metadata carries April 22.

renesas-honda-soc-2025-renesas.title: Honda and Renesas Sign Agreement to Develop High-Performance SoC for Software-Defined Vehicles (Renesas copy)
renesas-honda-soc-2025-renesas.note: Cited here for its foundry claim rather than its customer claim: the release states that the SoC uses TSMC's leading-edge 3-nm automotive process technology, which is Renesas, as the buyer of foundry capacity, naming its foundry. The 2012 announcement on the same pair concerned 90nm and 40nm microcontrollers, so this is a different and far newer product.

renesas-honda-soc-2025-honda.title: Honda and Renesas Sign Agreement to Develop High-Performance SoC for Software-Defined Vehicles (Honda copy)
renesas-honda-soc-2025-honda.note: Buyer-hosted copy of the joint release. Honda names Renesas and describes an SoC combining the Renesas fifth-generation R-Car X5 series with an AI accelerator Honda develops independently, targeted at Honda 0 Series models late in the 2020s. An agreement to develop, not a part in production.

renesas-vinfast-2022.title: VinFast and Renesas Sign Strategic Partnership to Advance Automobile Technology
renesas-vinfast-2022.note: Supplier names its customer and, unusually for a partnership release, names shipped product: Renesas states that its SoCs, R-Car and analog products have already been implemented in the VinFast VF8 and VF9, and that the expanded agreement will provide a broader range including microcontrollers and power semiconductors.

renesas-inventec-gateway-2023.title: Inventec and Renesas to Jointly Develop Proof-of-Concept for Automotive Gateways
renesas-inventec-gateway-2023.note: Supplier names its customer: Renesas will provide Inventec its latest offering of R-Car SoCs, analog and power products, along with engineering support, for a proof of concept for next-generation in-vehicle connected gateway systems.

renesas-nidec-eaxle-2023.title: Nidec and Renesas Collaborate on Semiconductor Solutions for Next-Generation E-Axle for EVs
renesas-nidec-eaxle-2023.note: Supplier names its customer: the two agreed to combine Nidec's motor technology and Renesas' semiconductor technology to jointly develop a proof of concept for an X-in-1 E-Axle system, with Renesas planning turnkey solutions built out of that PoC.

renesas-nidec-8in1-2024.title: Renesas Jointly Developed World-Class 8-in-1 Proof of Concept with Nidec, Delivering Advanced Integration for EV E-Axles
renesas-nidec-8in1-2024.note: The second phase of the same relationship, seventeen months on: Renesas states that it provided key components, including semiconductors and a reference design for the new 8-in-1 E-Axle system, which Nidec plans to productize. Still a proof of concept, shown at electronica 2024.

renesas-nullmax-adas-2025.title: Nullmax and Renesas Forge Strategic Partnership to Deliver Competitive ADAS Solutions for the Global Market
renesas-nullmax-adas-2025.note: Software partner names the silicon it builds on: the release describes ADAS solutions combining Nullmax's software with the performance of Renesas' R-Car V4 and R-Car X5 series chips. A design-in rather than a disclosed purchase — Nullmax writes software and the page does not state that it buys chips.

renesas-audi-pscp-2015.title: Renesas Electronics and Audi Agree on Strategic Partnership for Audi Progressive SemiConductor Program
renesas-audi-pscp-2015.note: Renesas and Audi established a strategic relationship as part of the Audi Progressive SemiConductor Program, a programme whose stated purpose is for the carmaker to be in direct contact with semiconductor manufacturers. Eleven years old at the date checked, and it names no part.

renesas-great-wall-nev-2017.title: Renesas Electronics and Great Wall Motors Announce Strategic Collaboration on Development of New Energy Vehicles and Self-Driving Cars
renesas-great-wall-nev-2017.note: Supplier names the carmaker: a collaboration to develop automotive semiconductor technologies and solutions that will spur the growth of advanced new energy vehicles. No part, volume or vehicle programme is named.

renesas-nevs-china-nev-2015.title: Renesas Electronics and Nevs Sign Strategic Partnership Agreement to Promote Technological Development for China New Energy Vehicle Industry
renesas-nevs-china-nev-2015.note: Supplier names its partner: the companies will join forces on the development of various system solutions targeting China's new energy vehicle market. Nevs has restructured since, and nothing in this set claims the relationship continued.

renesas-tata-elxsi-ev-2022.title: Tata Elxsi and Renesas Establish Next-Generation EV Innovation Center
renesas-tata-elxsi-ev-2022.note: Supplier names a design house: the two collaborate to create reference designs and solution accelerators for critical EV subsystems like battery management systems and motor control units. A design-services relationship around Renesas devices; the page does not state that Tata Elxsi buys silicon.

renesas-toyota-rav4-2026.title: Renesas R-Car V4H ADAS SoC Selected for Toyota RAV4 Model
renesas-toyota-rav4-2026.note: A design win, named at the part level: the R-Car V4H was selected for the TSS(LSS) control unit in Toyota's new RAV4, and the page states that the control unit is supplied by Denso Corporation. The strongest downstream document on this company — a named part, in a named unit, in a named vehicle.

renesas-continental-bodyhpc-2020.title: Renesas Advanced Automotive SoC Adopted by Continental for Its Body High-Performance Computer
renesas-continental-bodyhpc-2020.note: Supplier names the tier one and the part: Continental adopted the Renesas R-Car M3 SoC for its first-generation Body High-Performance Computer. A Continental executive is quoted saying that computer is already going into production at a global vehicle manufacturer, who is not named.

renesas-rcar-gen5-platform-2025.title: Renesas Fast-Tracks SDV Innovation with R-Car Gen 5 SoC-Based End-to-End Multi-Domain Solution Platform
renesas-rcar-gen5-platform-2025.note: Platform launch carrying quotes from two tier ones ahead of CES 2026: Bosch's Cross-Domain Computing Solutions division on integrating the R-Car X5 generation into its high-performance computing portfolio, and ZF's Electronics & ADAS division on combining the X5H with its own ADAS software. Silicon samples and evaluation boards are stated as shipping to select customers and partners. Nullmax is also named, among the software partners of the RoX Whitebox SDK.

renesas-rh850-u2c-bosch-2026.title: Renesas Expands Auto MCU Portfolio with 28nm RH850/U2C for Vehicle Control and Automotive Safety Applications
renesas-rh850-u2c-bosch-2026.note: A product launch whose customer quote is the evidence: Bosch's Chief Expert Semiconductor at Vehicle Motion says the 28nm MCUs offer strong performance and quality and that Bosch looks forward to continuing the collaboration, and that the RH850 family has long supported Bosch systems. The page names no foundry for the 28nm process.

renesas-rcar-x5h-3nm-2024.title: Renesas Unveils Industry's First Automotive Multi-Domain SoC Built with 3-nm Process Technology
renesas-rcar-x5h-3nm-2024.note: A product announcement that names two of its own inputs: 32 Arm Cortex-A720AE application cores and six Arm Cortex-R52 lockstep cores, and manufacture on TSMC's N3A automotive process, with a TSMC executive quoted. A buyer naming its IP supplier and its foundry in the same document.

renesas-synopsys-dso-ai-2021.title: Synopsys AI-Driven Design System Enables Renesas to Achieve Breakthrough in Productivity
renesas-synopsys-dso-ai-2021.note: Tool vendor names its customer: Synopsys announces the adoption of its DSO.ai design-space optimization system into the Renesas automotive design environment, with a Renesas director quoted. Design software, not silicon.

renesas-imagination-gpu-2025.title: Imagination GPU Powers Renesas R-Car Gen 5 SoC
renesas-imagination-gpu-2025.note: IP vendor names its licensee: the IMG BXS automotive-grade B-Series GPU is licensed by Renesas and powers the next-generation R-Car Gen 5 SoC. The two companies have licensed graphics IP to each other's products since at least 2011, when the agreement covered the PowerVR Series6 family. No volume or royalty figure is given.

renesas-cadence-verisium-2023.title: Cadence Verisium AI-Driven Verification Platform Accelerates Debug Productivity for Renesas
renesas-cadence-verisium-2023.note: Cadence's own press release, carrying its San Jose dateline and 'today announced' wording, read on EE Journal because both cadence.com and the Business Wire original answer 403 to an automated fetch. The release names the Verisium platform and its AutoTriage, SemanticDiff, WaveMiner, PinDown, Debug and Manager apps as deployed by Renesas on an R-Car SoC, and quotes the president of Renesas Design Vietnam. The productivity multiples in it are the vendor's own.

renesas-gen6-ddr5-rcd-2025.title: Renesas' Industry-First Gen6 DDR5 Registered Clock Driver Sets Performance Benchmark by Delivering 9600 MT/s
renesas-gen6-ddr5-rcd-2025.note: A product launch whose customer quote carries the evidence: Samsung's VP of DRAM Product Planning says Samsung has collaborated with Renesas across multiple generations of memory interface components, including the successful qualification of Gen5 DDR5 RCD and PMIC5030, and that it will integrate Gen6 into its DDR5 DIMMs. The Gen6 part itself is sampling, with production expected in the first half of 2027; the page claims 'all major DRAM suppliers' as sampling customers without naming them.

renesas-industrial-rcd-micron-2021.title: Renesas Introduces Industry's First Industrial Temperature Grade DDR5 and DDR4 Registered Clock Drivers
renesas-industrial-rcd-micron-2021.note: Product launch quoting Micron's VP and GM of Core Compute Business on a collaboration with partners like Renesas opening new markets for memory at the intelligent edge. Read carefully, the quote does not say that Micron uses these parts, and the page makes no qualification or deployment claim about Micron.

renesas-nissan-skyline-propilot-2019.title: Renesas Electronics Innovative Automotive Chips Adopted by Nissan for its New Skyline ProPILOT 2.0
renesas-nissan-skyline-propilot-2019.note: Supplier names the carmaker and the parts: Nissan adopted the Renesas R-Car SoC and RH850 control MCU for the ProPILOT 2.0 system in the Skyline unveiled in July 2019. The R-Car builds the environment map, the RH850 sends commands to the steering, accelerator and brake ECUs.

renesas-nissan-leaf-propilot-park-2017.title: Renesas' SoC and MCU Adopted by Nissan for its New LEAF Automated-Parking System
renesas-nissan-leaf-propilot-park-2017.note: The earlier of two Nissan releases: the R-Car SoC and RH850 MCU adopted for ProPILOT Park in the LEAF that debuted on 2017-09-06. The R-Car recognises the parking space and issues acceleration, braking, steering and shifting commands.

renesas-distribution-consolidation-2020.title: Renesas Continues its Transformation with Distribution Channel Consolidation Guided by Sharpened Market Strategy and Broader Portfolio to Serve More Customers
renesas-distribution-consolidation-2020.note: Renesas names its own channel: Avnet, Future Electronics and WT Microelectronics as its top three distributors, with WT newly engaged and the WPI Group relationship terminated. Six years old at the date checked, and a distribution agreement is a route to market rather than a disclosed volume. WPI is deliberately NOT recorded as an edge: this document is the only one naming it, and what it says is that the relationship ended.
